purpose: Pre-register an independent integrated field benchmark for direct adjacency, transport age, and reaction-family identifiability.

current_field_packages.role: refined Central Region hydrochemistry and well-construction cohort
refined Upper East Region chemistry, isotope and tracer cohort

direct_adjacency.independent_label_rule: Use a pre-registered hydraulic/tracer/pathline reference independent of HydroSheaf. Label direct only when P(direct | independent evidence) >= 0.95 and every supported indirect alternative is <= 0.05; otherwise retain ambiguous.
direct_adjacency.age_likelihood: Compare endpoint age increment to an independently estimated segment travel-time posterior; endpoint-age ordering alone is direction/reachability evidence, not a direct-edge label.

transport_age.reference: multi-tracer age or breakthrough posterior with uncertainty and model diagnostics

reaction_family.independent_label_rule: Use an independent mineralogical, isotopic, or controlled-tracer determination not used as an inference feature.

geology_dictionary_contract.use: Apply as a bounded prior/context term. Never convert a surface-map association into screened lithology, flow truth, or a reaction label; unmatched or boundary records remain unknown.

ratio_diagnostics.use: diagnostic and prior evidence only; do not append ratios to a reaction matrix that already contains their numerator and denominator ions
ratio_diagnostics.edge_score: Use a covariance-weighted endpoint change r_e = r(v) - r(u), with detection limits and missing pairs retained explicitly; report n_available and abstain when the declared minimum pair count is not met.

analysis_gates.no_label_leakage: No independent confirmation field may be used to generate the prediction being scored.
analysis_gates.split_policy: Hold out complete wells or connected flow-system clusters; never split repeated samples from one well across train and test.
analysis_gates.direct_edge_gate: Require the independent label rule and a finite segment travel-time posterior; otherwise ABSTAIN for direct adjacency.
analysis_gates.age_gate: Require at least one declared age tracer plus uncertainty and a transport model/segment estimate; endpoint ages alone receive only direction compatibility.
analysis_gates.reaction_gate: Require the declared ion panel, units, charge-balance/QC status, and an independent reference for accuracy scoring; otherwise report screening identifiability only.
analysis_gates.geology_gate: Mapped geology is metadata/context. A geology dictionary prior cannot create field truth or override an unmatched join.

success_definition.complete_integrated_benchmark: A run may be called integrated only if the same pre-registered well IDs have co-timed chemistry, age, heads/screens, geology/lithology, and independent edge/reaction labels, with a frozen crosswalk and held-out confirmation.
success_definition.current_status: The refined Central Region and Upper East Region cohorts are separate cross-sectional transfer/context panels. They do not satisfy the integrated blind-confirmation definition and must remain ABSTAIN/screening for field age, direct adjacency, temporal transfer, and reaction-truth claims.
